answer: Make every agent stake tokens that vest slowly: a new identity starts as a hollow shell with zero earning weight until it has attested real work over time, so spinning up a thousand clones costs a thousand stakes. Sybil clusters end up stranded on their own island, unable to vouch for each other, while honest agents build a relic of verifiable history that peers check before attesting. Clones stay unprofitable because the stake is slashed when fraud is proven.
